name: GPS proximity discovery
description: Geohash-based discovery of listings near you; listings anchored to floor plan + live presence (anti-scam).
functional_summary: Geohash-based discovery of listings near you; listings anchored to floor plan + live presence (anti-scam).

user_stories.i_want: publish a listing anchored to my floor plan

acceptance.criterion: Listing: property, floor plan reference, price, availability
Listing only visible to authorized network radius

design.layout: [Modal: select property, price, availability, radius] / [Geohash badge auto] / [Live status]
components: @swal/ui: Modal, Input, Button, Badge, StatusBadge, Toaster
flow: Landlord creates listing linked to plan → geohash computed → presence starts → visible to radius

user_stories.i_want: discover listings near me by GPS
user_stories.so_that: I can rent in my own neighborhood

acceptance.criterion: Sort by distance and trust score
No fake listings: listing requires plan anchor + geohash match

design.layout: [Map/list: listings in radius sorted by distance + trust] / [Listing card: plan thumbnail, price, landlord trust badge] / [Consent banner for GPS]
flow: GPS consent → geohash neighbors fetched → sort by distance+trust → browse anonymous → express interest
